newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks up on bonus shr announcement.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks up on bonus shr announcement.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks, which started flat in dull pre-holiday trade, were pepped up by a bonus share announcement by a blue chip holding company on Thursday, brokers said.
The all share index was 0.22 points up by the mid-morning break.
"The market is dull with retail investors who generally add life to it, keeping out due to the holidays," said Commercial Stock Broker's trader Ajit Dias Wanigasekera.
"But it did come to life briefly when John Keells Holdings announced their bonus issue," he said.

John Keells, a blue chip holding company, announced a one for seven bonus issue. Company chairman Ken Balendra said the bonus was a reward for shareholders after the group had "not done too badly under trying conditions in the first six months of 1996".
Early turnover was 8.7 million rupees, with the main trades being 775,000 Forbes Ceylon at 4.75 rupees.
Final turnover is expected to improve once a parcel of 950,000 Kotagala Plantations, on bid at 26 rupees, is concluded, brokers said.
